content: Tami buetbuet touh ni a hmu e hoi a panue e hno dawk, kapanuekkhaikung lah ao teh, a pathang e thoebonae a thai nahlangva, dei laipalah awm pawiteh, yonpennae teh ama ni a khang han.
Tami buetbuet touh ni kathounghoehe sarang, saring, vonpui hoi kâva e saring kathoung hoeh e kadout e ro tek pawiteh yonpen lah ao han.
Hot hnukkhu hoi, tami hanelah kathounghoehe, kakhin e lah kaawm e hno, a kâbet payon e hah bout a panue torei teh yon pen lah ao han.
Tami buetbuet touh ni kahawi hno thoseh, kathout hno thoseh, sut pouk laipalah lawkkamnae a sak teh, thoe a bo. Hote lawkkamnae bout a kâpanue torei teh, yon pen lah ao han.
Hetpatete yonpennae buet buet touh ao torei teh, Bangpatete nakunghai ama ni yonpâpho naseh.
A sakpayon e yontha nahanlah tu thoseh, hmae thoseh, a napui ca buetbuet touh yon thueng nahanelah, Cathut koe a thokhai hnukkhu, vaihma ni hote tami hanelah yon thuengnae a sak pouh han.
Tuca tawn hoehpawiteh, a sak payonnae yontha nahanlah sathei buet touh hmai thueng nahanlah buet touh, bakhu kahni touh, hoeh pawiteh âbakhu kahni touh BAWIPA koe vaihma hmalah a thokhai han.
Vaihma ni yonthanae sathei hah hmaloe thuengnae a sak han. A lahuen a kapen vaiteh, a tâtueng han. A tak teh na sei mahoeh.
Hote yon thuengnae sathei thi hah, khoungroe tapang dawk a kahei vaiteh, kacawie a thi teh, khoungroe kung koe a paca han. Hethateh, yon thuengnae doeh.
Apâhni e tava teh a lamthung patetlah hmai thuengnae patetlah thuengnae a sak han. Hottelah, Vaihma ni ahnie a sakpayon e yon hanlah yonthanae a sak pouh pawiteh, ahnie yon teh tha lah ao han.

Bakhu kahni touh thoseh, âbakhu kahni touh thoseh, buetbuet touh coung thai hoehpawiteh, yon ka sak e tami ni yon thuengnae sathei yueng lah tavai ephah pung hra pung touh a thokhai han. Yon thuengnae lah ao dawkvah satui hoi frankinsen na awi mahoeh.
Vaihma koe na thokhai hnukkhu, vaihma ni tavai vai touh kasum a la vaiteh, BAWIPA koe hmai thuengnae hoi cungtalah khoungroe van hmai a sawi han. Hethateh, yon thuengnae lah ao.
Hettelah, vaihma ni hote tami ni a sakpayon e yon hanelah yon thuengnae sak pawiteh ahnie yontha lah ao han. Kacawie teh tavai thuengnae patetlah vaihma hanelah ao han telah Mosi koe atipouh.
Kâtapoe thuengnae
BAWIPA ni Mosi koe bout a dei pouh e teh,

Tami buetbuet touh ni phunglawk panuek laipalah BAWIPA hoi kâkuen e hno dawk payon pawiteh, hote payonnae hanlah yonthanae sathei tie tutan hmuen kathoung koe e patetlah ngun tangka a to vaiteh, BAWIPA koe a thokhai han.

Hottelah, BAWIPA hoi kâkuen e hno dawk, a sakpayon e hanlah, panga touh dawk buet touh a thapsin vaiteh, vaihma koe a poe han. Vaihma ni hai yonthanae sathei lah kaawm e tu hoi hote tami hanelah yonthanae sak pouh pawiteh, ahnie yon teh tha lah ao han.
Tami buetbuet touh ni BAWIPA ni kâ a poe e sakpayon pawiteh, a sak payonnae ama ni a panue hoeh nakunghai a sak hno teh ama ni a khang han.

Yonnae ngaithoum nahanelah, kacueme tutan, vaihma koe a thokhai han. Phunglawk panuek laipalah, a sakpayon nakunghai, amahoima yonnae kâpanuek hoeh e tami hanelah vaihma ni yonthanae sak pouh pawiteh, ahnie yon teh tha lah ao han.
Hettelah, BAWIPA ka taran niteh, kâ kaek katang e kâtapoe thuengnae doeh telah ati.
